title: config path
description: Where e-designer keeps things, from config path: this machine's config, data and token, then the project's designs and its board's .env, so the board's Settings and a person at a terminal see the same places. Paths are the machine's, shown on purpose behind the token, as the board names its project's folder (ED-RUN-2).

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ConfigPath, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: One row per place, the machine's first, then the project's.

key.description: Names the place for a program, which never reads the label: an open word. Known words: config, data, token, designs, board.

path.description: Where it is on this machine, absolute; the token's path only, never the token.

note.description: What it holds, for people; absent when the label says enough.
